layout_sources: https://forums.moneysavingexpert.com/discussion/5803620/which-bank-download-old-statement-data-in-excel (HSBC CSV: three columns, date, details, amount)

notes: No header row: date (DD/MM/YYYY), description in quotes, signed amount (money out negative). No balance, no currency. Amounts of 1,000 or more carry a thousands comma and are then quoted ("1,850.00"); quoting of the amount is the most widely reported form but not confirmed. Oldest first per one importer (not confirmed). Line endings unknown (LF here).
